subject: Re: Zenfolio — Security architecture readout and SOC 2 evidence review
messages:
From: Rajiv Mehta <r.mehta@zenfolio.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@zenfolio.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Security architecture readout request — SOC 2, encryption, audit logs, SSO

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. Zenfolio is preparing for our SOC 2 Type II scope and we want to do a focused architecture readout so your engineering/security folks can validate where Redwood would sit in our control set. Key areas we want covered:

- SOC 2 artifact map (where customer-visible logs / artifacts live)
- Encryption at rest and in transit, key management model
- Audit logging and retention options (access logs, admin actions)
- SSO integration (SAML/OIDC) and session handling

Would your team be available next week for a 60-minute technical review? We prefer mornings PST. I’ve attached our questionnaire to give you a sense of expected evidence.

Prelim attendees from our side: Rajiv Mehta (Security Lead), Aisha Khan (Platform PM).

Thanks,
Rajiv
Zenfolio Security
Attachment: zenfolio_security_questions.pdf (pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Mehta <r.mehta@zenfolio.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security architecture readout request — SOC 2, encryption, audit logs, SSO

Rajiv — thanks for the detail and the questionnaire. Markus (solutions engineering) and Soojin (security architect) will join to walk through our architecture and map artifacts to your SOC 2 control set.

Two proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Aug 25, 9:00–10:00am PST
- Wed Aug 26, 10:30–11:30am PST

If those don't work we can do Thu afternoon.

We can share a short artifact index ahead of time (spreadsheet) and a one-page encryption summary. I'll attach the artifact index and a short notes PDF for your team to review. Also sharing a Drive folder where we can drop logs and sample config snippets after we confirm the attendees.

Action items:
- Rajiv: confirm preferred slot and any extra attendees (legal/compliance ok to join)
- We: drop redwood_soc2_artifact_index.xlsx and encryption_key_rotation_notes.pdf into the Drive link below before the meeting.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cZENFOLIO

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Security Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_soc2_artifact_index.xlsx (xlsx), encryption_key_rotation_notes.pdf (pdf)

From: Rajiv Mehta <r.mehta@zenfolio.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@zenfolio.com>
Date: 2026-08-21T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Security architecture readout request — SOC 2, encryption, audit logs, SSO

Thanks Mina — appreciate the options. Wed Aug 26 at 10:30am PST would be ideal, but we just had a legal sync get bumped into that slot. Would it be possible to move to Wed Aug 26 at 2:00–3:00pm PST instead? If your team can do 2pm, I will loop in our legal/compliance folks so we can cover evidence mapping and customer-facing controls in the same meeting.

Also — can you include in the artifact index the mapping to control IDs (e.g., CC6.1 / LOG-01) and example log snippets for admin actions? That will help our reviewers triage.

Thanks,
Rajiv
Attachment: none

Rajiv, Mina — Wed Aug 26 at 2:00–3:00pm PST works for us. I’ll be the lead for the walkthrough and Soojin will cover encryption/keys and SSO flows.

Per Rajiv's ask I've added a control-ID column to the artifact index and a folder with sample admin log snippets. You can find everything in the Drive link Mina shared. Quick notes on what we uploaded:
- redwood_soc2_artifact_index.xlsx — includes control mapping (column: Zen_Control_ID)
- encryption_key_rotation_notes.pdf — KMS model and rotation cadence
- sample_admin_logs.log — redacted admin action entries (timestamped, user ids hashed)

We will not share production customer PII; logs are redacted. If you need additional control crosswalks (SOC2 -> ISO/other frameworks) let us know and we can prepare a short appendix.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cZENFOLIO

-Markus
Solutions Engineering — Redwood Inference
